People: Richard Steele (author, Wikidata Q333148), died 1729; Joseph Addison (author, Wikidata Q206384), died 1719; George Atherton Aitken (editor, Wikidata Q15930536), died 1917. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Steele, Richard, Sir, 1672-1729; Addison, Joseph, 1672-1719; Aitken, George Atherton, 1860-1917 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Tatler, with notes and a general index. Complete in one volume, Philadelphia, J.J. Woodward, 1709, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/tatlerguardian00steegoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 57%, 89%, 62% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of George Atherton Aitken, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
